mapper.select: select id, task_id, channel_id, interface_id, channel_name, parameter_name, tm_symbol, telemetry_value, detail, is_deleted, create_time from calib_record_detail where task_id = #{taskId} and channel_id = #{channelId} and is_deleted = 0 order by create_time desc, id desc
mapper.update: update calib_record_detail set is_deleted = 1 where channel_id = #{channelId} and is_deleted = 0
